{{recipe}}

This is a recipe for a basic unbaked cheesecake. The measurements can easily be doubled if needed to make it bigger.

== Ingredients ==

* 75 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] + 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 200 g (7 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) tennis biscuits or [[Cookbook:Digestive Biscuit|digestive biscuits]], crushed to fine crumbs
* 540 g (19 oz) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], softened to room temperature
* 750 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (26.4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) tinned [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
* 10 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]]) [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]

== Special equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|Springform pan]]
* [[Cookbook:Mixer|Handheld mixer]]/beater or stand mixer
* Measuring cups and spoons

== Procedure ==

# Combine melted butter with biscuit crumbs. Press into a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie dish]] to make a crust.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] cream cheese until smooth and fluffy.
# Beat lemon juice and condensed milk together.
# Mix the condensed milk mixture into beaten cream cheese until thoroughly combined.
# Pour filling into the prepared pie dish.
# Refrigerate for minimum of 24 hours until set.
